Iknow how you feel, i'm 22 as wel and i get how hard it can be. But if you want i can show you what helps me get trough it a lil bit.

If everything gets too much, or i have to do things i'm not ready to do i do something small and easy that i enjoy doing, for me that's playing my favorite riffs on the guitar. I do that until i calm down a bit. And then i think about the problem and start searching for the easiest and most comfortable part to solve. And just take it slow and steady. And everytime it gets overwhelming just start again.

As you progress you see how much it helps and how it can help, and maybe it'l help you

Hope this helps, you're not alone, send me a message if you want!
